'''Oln Rannar''' was an aide to the [[King/Legends|King]] [[Regalun Petryph]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Rannar send the [[Alliance Commander]] a message inviting them to the funeral proceedings of Petryph's cousins, [[Anosek]] and [[Anoser]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|Your Presense is Requested|Oln Rannar}}</ref>
